project.description: Workspace project to configure. Defaults to the only application in the workspace.

theme.description: Optional theme stylesheet to register. The default look needs nothing — component styles ship inside the components. 'dark' adds the dark theme (activate with class="oge-theme-dark", data-oge-theme="dark", or 'auto' to follow the OS); 'high-contrast' adds the high-contrast theme (activate with class="oge-theme-high-contrast" or data-oge-theme="high-contrast"); 'tailwind' and 'bootstrap' bridge the --oge-* tokens onto an existing design system. The stylesheets ship in @oge-ui/core, which is added as a direct dependency when missing.

skipAgentsFile.description: Do not write the OGE usage block into AGENTS.md.
